name: Data.nominalWeight_add_le
summary: nominalWeight(D, σ) ≤ a(D)/x(D) ≤ (x(D)·b(D) + N₁(D))/x(D) = b(D) + N₁(D)/x(D), so it suffices that N₁(D)/x(D) + x(D)⁴² ≤ b(D), a comparison of monomials in the scales.

steps.claim: By nominalWeight(D, σ) ≤ a(D)/x(D) (`nominalWeight_mem_Icc`), a(D) = roundUp(D, x(D)·b(D)) ≤ x(D)·b(D) + N₁(D) (`roundUp_mem_Icc`) and 2b(D) = b(D) + b(D), the claim follows from x(D)·b(D)/x(D) + (N₁(D)/x(D) + x(D)⁴²) ≤ b(D) + b(D).
steps.lean:
grw [(nominalWeight_mem_Icc ..).2, a, D.roundUp_mem_Icc.2, two_mul, add_div,
    add_assoc];

steps.claim: After x(D)·b(D)/x(D) = b(D) (x(D) > 0) it remains N₁(D)/x(D) + x(D)⁴² ≤ b(D), a comparison of monomials in the scales, which `le_of_hasLogBound` proves. With the exponents as this reader computes them from the instances (instance search's own choice is not recorded): the upper exponent of the left side is 42·logX(D) + 1 (the exponent of N₁(D) = N₀(P)·towerDeg(s(D)) minus logX(D) is below 42·logX(D)), the lower exponent of b(D) is logB(D), and 42·logX(D) + 1 < logB(D) by the scale conditions (logB(D) ≥ 10¹²·logX(D)).
